package.name: arm_sensors
package.description: Driver bringup for the arm's onboard sensors. Currently: the OV5693 5MP camera, via USB/UVC (v4l2src) for dev-machine testing today, or MIPI CSI (nvarguscamerasrc, on Jetson) for the eventual real deployment. Both backends run through the same gscam node, switched via the "backend" launch argument, and publish to the same topic names/frame_id the simulated wrist camera already uses (see arm_sim's arm_gazebo.launch.py / panel detection pipeline) so downstream consumers (aruco_tracker, panel_pose_fuser_node) need no changes to run against real hardware.
